text: On July 25, 2022, Official Plan Amendment, Zoning By-law Amendment and Draft Plan of Subdivision applications were deemed complete for a proposed mixed-use development including a 10-storey mid-rise building, an eight-storey base building including a mezzanine floor and a 33-storey tower at 2405-2411 and 2417 Lake Shore Boulevard West. A Rental Housing Demolition Application was also submitted to demolish 22 rental units. On February 13, 2023, the applicant appealed the applications to the Ontario Land Tribunal citing City Council's failure to make a decision on the applications within the time period prescribed under the Planning Act. A Case Management Conference was held on July 13. Mayer Investment Limited, the owner of lands which directly abut the subject property on Superior Road, was granted party status.
